product.name: Charming
product.shortDescription: Build and iterate hosted web apps
product.packageDescription: Create, update, and inspect Charming-hosted interactive web apps via the Charming MCP server.
product.longDescription: Charming is an MCP server that generates, hosts, and updates small interactive web apps. Each app gets a real URL, persistent storage, and inline rendering in MCP Apps-capable clients, and it stays live at that URL for anyone you share it with.

defaultPrompts: Build me a personal web app with Charming.
Update my Charming app from feedback.
Connect Charming MCP in this session.

clients.label: Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, and most MCP clients
ChatGPT
clients.note: one-click via the Charming listing in the ChatGPT Apps directory; this paste-string is the Developer Mode fallback

tools.name: create_app
tools.summary: Store an agent-authored module (a `manifest` plus `routes`) with optional UI and CSS, and render it inline. Requires a `description`. Give the user the returned token-free `shareUrl`, never the machine-only `url`.

tools.name: update_app
tools.summary: Edit an existing app by replacing its module/UI/styles/description or applying exact-string edits, with optimistic-concurrency versioning.

tools.name: get_app
tools.summary: Render an existing app inline (where the client supports it) and return its callable API operations and metadata.

tools.name: get_app_source
tools.summary: Return the persisted module, UI, and styles for an existing app plus its current version.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.summary: List the caller's apps plus apps shared with them, newest first, with each app's role, description, and capabilities.

tools.name: delete_app
tools.summary: Permanently delete an app you own. Irreversible and confirmation-gated: it fails closed until re-invoked with `confirm: true`. Pass `purge_storage: true` to also wipe stored state.

tools.name: upload_asset
tools.summary: Store a static asset (image, PDF, dataset) so app code stays small; readable back same-origin.

tools.name: rename_app
tools.summary: Change an app's URL slug. The old URL keeps working by redirecting.

tools.name: set_remixable
tools.summary: Mark an app remixable so visitors get their own editable copy.

tools.name: unset_remixable
tools.summary: Stop allowing remixes; existing remixes survive untouched.

tools.name: set_starter_prompt
tools.summary: Set or clear the prompt prefilled in the chat host when a visitor opens a shared app.

tools.name: query_app
tools.summary: Run a read-only backend operation inside an app module.

tools.name: mutate_app
tools.summary: Run a mutating backend operation inside an app module without editing code.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.summary: Record agent-authored feedback (bugs, enhancements, crash reports) about an app.

tools.name: list_feedback
tools.summary: List feedback rows for the caller's apps, newest first.

tools.name: set_handle
tools.summary: Change the signed-in user's handle (the first segment of their app URLs).

tools.name: share_app
tools.summary: Invite someone to an app as `collaborator` (default), `end-user` (run and write data, cannot edit source), or `viewer` (read-only). Calling it again with a role changes their role in place.

tools.name: unshare_app
tools.summary: Revoke access for any grantee, whether the invitation is still pending or already accepted.

tools.name: list_app_shares
tools.summary: List active and pending share invites for one of your apps.

tools.name: set_public
tools.summary: Make an app public: anyone with the URL can open it with no login and read AND write its shared data. Warn the user that every anonymous visitor shares one data pool, so anyone with the URL can overwrite or wipe it.

tools.name: unset_public
tools.summary: Make a public app private again; anonymous visitors can no longer open it.

tools.name: set_template
tools.summary: Publish an app as a template so anyone opening its URL gets their own brand-new copy, leaving the original untouched. Pass `listed: true` to also list it in the public directory. Omitting `listed` leaves the current listing state alone. The app must be claimed first.

tools.name: unset_template
tools.summary: Stop treating an app as a template: new visitors can no longer copy it, and any public listing is cleared. Existing copies survive.

tools.name: search_templates
tools.summary: Search the public Charming template directory by keyword. Check here for an existing template before calling `create_app`, or when the user asks what templates exist. Each hit carries a `copyUrl` a visitor can open to mint their own independent copy with no login.
